inputs.checklistItemText: Electrical routing from transformer to meter not 100% on private property
inputs.question: On the electrical plan, is the routing from the transformer pads to the electrical meters and buildings shown? Does the routing stay completely within private property or does it cross right-of-way or easements?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether electrical routing is shown on the plan and whether it crosses property boundaries/ROW/easements. This is a presence-and-path-visibility question (does the routing appear, and can we see if it stays on private property), not a precise distance measurement between two fixed points. The routing-crossing determination requires visual inspection of line paths relative to property/easement boundaries, but the core question is feature presence and general spatial relationship, not quantified clearance measurement.
